cases.instruction: Task description: Based on the income and expenditure of hospitals at all levels (hospital_finance_2025.csv), liabilities (liabilities_2025.csv), drug production data (drug_production_2025.csv), per capita medical expenses (medical_expenses_2025.csv) and local chronic disease data (chronic_disease_2025.csv), evaluate the relationship between hospital financial health and disease burden. It is necessary to complete data merging, calculation of key indicators (balance ratio, asset-liability ratio, average cost per time, pharmaceutical output value), correlation analysis between financial performance and chronic disease prevalence in each region, identification of high-risk areas, financial optimization and resource allocation recommendations, and finally generate an analysis report Hospital_Finance_Disease_Report.pptx.

findings.summary: The report provides a usable provincial merge, asset-liability ratios, medical-cost comparisons and management recommendations, and correctly explains why provincial financial–disease correlations and pharmaceutical output value cannot be calculated. However, it incorrectly labels every hospital expenditure and balance ratio as missing or uncomputable despite explicit expenditure values in the source, leaving a required financial indicator unfinished.

The supplied pages are readable, with consistent title hierarchy, strong contrast and aligned tables. Minor table-layout shortcomings on pages 2 and 7 create awkward wrapping and crowded row boundaries. No major clipping or overlap is visible.

The three preceding reports are mutually consistent and support retaining PARTIAL. Source accuracy cannot be independently established from these summaries alone.

cases.instruction:
Task description: Prepare a presentation on "Annual Benefit Analysis and Future Planning of the Volunteer Association". Given the following files:
• Annual event photo album (activity_photos/): Contains representative photos of each event (for on-site display)
• Benefit trend table (impact_chart.csv): shows changes in key indicators such as total annual service time, audience size, etc.
• Volunteer feedback word cloud (feedback_wordcloud.png): displays high-frequency suggested keywords
• Draft future plan (strategic_plan_1.md): including key projects, expected goals, and resource requirements
• Recruitment diagram for new positions (recruitment_poster.png): including position name, number of people to be recruited, and skill requirements
Extract key information from the above documents and integrate it to generate a PPT presentation Volunteer_Annual_Review.pptx. The content must include the annual event presentation, benefit analysis (with trend charts), future planning, and new recruitment directions (with new recruitment graphics). And save it to the /Volunteer Activities/ directory. The pictures are required to be beautiful, focusing on annual results and recruitment attraction.

findings.summary: The presentation provides clearly labeled planning and recruitment proposals and accurately preserves the supplied commercial metrics. However, it remains a planning draft: annual events are placeholders, the trend concerns corporate revenue targets rather than volunteer benefits, and recruitment headcounts are unresolved. The authorized sources do not supply the requested volunteer records or assets. Visual quality, native graphics and the required save location cannot be verified from this text evidence.

Consistent typography, colors and slide hierarchy make most content readable. However, multiple cards overflow, one heading crowds its body text, and both chart titles have very poor contrast. These visible defects substantially reduce presentation polish and readability.

The selected pages have clear hierarchy, strong contrast and consistent alignment. Minor localized layout issues remain: the first timeline card has insufficient bottom padding, and a source filename wraps awkwardly. No major overlap or unreadable content is visible.

The three reports are consistent within their stated scopes and establish partial fulfillment. Substantive content obligations remain unmet, and visual defects are reported. Agreement on page 8 supports consistency across the overlapping visual reviews. Original-source accuracy, native graphics and the required save location remain unverified; this review does not establish complete-task accuracy.
